a: PinRepair converts a numeric pin's text per keystroke, so a decimal cannot be typed and a cleared or signed value turns the pin into a string for good
SemanticDrawer's literal Value field loses a number for good once the field is cleared (untyped rule)
"Discard the draft and reload from disk" clears the draft without waiting, then remounts from `loadDraft`, which can still return the draft
Save stays enabled while the draft does not derive, so a broken definition can be written to disk
A stored preset named like a built-in is loaded alongside it: duplicate React keys, and one name for two presets
b: A list-valued pin in PinRepair cannot be typed: the controlled field round-trips each keystroke through parse and serialize
Step lists are read without the theme's scope in three places and with it in three others
The theme prefs page's undo history has no limit
PinRepair's "named in the error" check matches any reference that appears as a substring of the message
A stored preset list can hold duplicate or built-in names, which collide as React keys and show twice
"Varies by" does nothing when switched off on a branch the rule lacks
The light and dark surface colors are defined twice, in PaletteLab and PalettePreview
pickRule and leafAt are two implementations of reading a leaf at a selection, and they differ on a `by` key
